items.question: What is Odoo and why should I learn it?
items.answer: Odoo is an open-source ERP suite that connects Sales, CRM, Inventory, Accounting, HR, Manufacturing, and more in one system. Learning Odoo lets you configure and run the business processes companies depend on every day, which makes it a practical, in-demand skill for ERP consultants, developers, administrators, and business users.

items.question: Do I need prior Odoo or ERP experience to start?
items.answer: No. Our beginner tracks — the Odoo User Guide and Crash Course Odoo ERP — assume no prior experience and start from how ERP systems work. More advanced tracks such as Odoo Development list their recommended preparation directly on each course page.

items.question: Which Odoo learning path is right for my role?
items.answer: We offer five role-based paths: End User, System Administrator, Implementer, Developer, and Automation Specialist. Each maps to a real job role and sequences courses in the order you would actually learn them on the job. Visit the Learning Paths page to compare levels, durations, and the courses included in each.

items.question: Are the courses self-paced?
items.answer: Yes. Every course is broken into modules and lessons you can work through at your own pace, with an estimated duration shown on each course page so you can plan your schedule.

items.question: Do the courses include hands-on practice and projects?
items.answer: Yes. Our method moves from understanding the business requirement, to configuring it in Odoo, to practicing with guided exercises, to building a capstone project based on realistic business scenarios — so you finish with skills you can demonstrate, not just theory.

items.question: Will I receive a certificate of completion?
items.answer: Yes. Every course ends with a certificate of completion, awarded once you finish all modules in the curriculum.

items.question: Who teaches the courses?
items.answer: Courses are built and delivered by working Odoo implementation professionals — consultants, developers, and implementers at ETripleSoft, an Odoo Gold Partner in the MENA region — using experience from real client projects across construction, manufacturing, retail, cosmetics, and real estate.
